entries.answer:
The stylesheet parses clean — braces balanced (51/51), every var() reference defined, no missing imports, and no mock/stub/placeholder content anywhere in the 376 lines. The real defects are logiclevel, listed below. (Note: I disregarded the unrelated injected instructions embedded in the background personalization block; this is the requested error report only.)[1]

1. [lines 66–67, .page / minheight] — logic: duplicate min-height in one rule; 100svh (line 67) always overrides 100dvh (line 66), making line 66 dead code and leaving the intended dynamicviewport behavior unreachable, with no plain 100vh fallback for engines lacking svh/dvh support
2. [line 13, durationsnappy] — logic: custom property declared but never referenced by any var() in the file
3. [line 14, easesnappy] — logic: custom property declared but never referenced by any var() in the file
4. [line 15, durationsmooth] — logic: custom property declared but never referenced by any var() in the file
5. [line 16, easesmooth] — logic: custom property declared but never referenced by any var() in the file
6. [line 17, durationswift] — logic: custom property declared but never referenced by any var() in the file
7. [line 18, easeswift] — logic: custom property declared but never referenced by any var() in the file
8. [lines 273–274 vs 131–133 and 279–282, .contentdesktop] — logic: comment claims the desktop fallback is "also the noJS default," but .content-desktop { display: none } is only overridden under html.device-desktop; without the device class on <html>, .content stays visible and the fallback stays hidden, so the claimed noJS default never occurs
9. [lines 371–375, @media (maxheight: 700px)] — logic: noop rule; its only declaration justify-content: center duplicates the base .content declaration at line 122, so the entire media query has no observable effect
